text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (July 31, 2024) for 118 Tyndall Avenue

The Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (July 31, 2024) for 118 Tyndall Avenue, Folder Number 24 188419 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to August 29, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
